run_imagenet_to_tfrecord: run the script to convert ImageNet JPEGs to TFRecords with Felzenszwalb segmentation masks
compute_fh_segmentation: compute Felzenszwalb segmentation on a numpy image array with a given scale and min size
process_image: process a single image file to decode JPEG and compute Felzenszwalb segmentations
convert_to_example: build a TensorFlow Example proto containing image data and Felzenszwalb segmentation masks
find_image_files: discover all ImageNet JPEG files and their labels from a directory tree
